scope: Independent review of new diagram-to-target associations that were not already in the original target record_ids. These links do not modify the original catalogue, device or panel records.
method: Read original source text and inspected selected complete-page images. Applicability is established by explicit source model names and figure scope, not by matching titles or manufacturer names.

evidence: The source cover identifies XFP Single Loop 16 Zone Version, DFU1200510 Rev 1.
Page 9 shows the single analogue-loop connection to the main board. Page 10 identifies conventional sounder, auxiliary input and relay connections.
approved.limits: Do not substitute the separate 32-zone panel edition.

evidence: The source cover explicitly identifies XFP 1 or 2 Loop 32 Zone Version, DFU2200510 Rev 2.
Pages 9–11 identify loop connections (including an additional loop connector if applicable), sounder/input/relay connections, and RS232/battery connections.
approved.limits: The second loop exists only if fitted, as stated by the source; this edition is separate from the 16-zone panel.

evidence: The complete page is explicitly labelled Vigilon 4/6 loop panels and Figure 13, Typical terminal card 8 zones.
The combined manual also covers Compact, but this selected page establishes the 4/6-loop model applicability directly.
approved.limits: A terminal-card layout does not establish general compatibility between Compact and 4/6-loop panels.

evidence: The source cover identifies Syncro Multi Loop Analogue Addressable Fire Control Panel, Man-1055 Issue 26 May 2016.
Page 7 is the terminal-plate layout; page 16 separately shows FIRE ROUTING and MONITORED AUX output examples; page 28 shows the Syncro node network IN/OUT ring.
approved.limits: The network-ring picture is not detector-loop wiring. Source conditions and board requirements remain visible on the full page.

evidence: The original PDF header states: SENSORS COVERED: ACC, ATJ, ALG, ACA, ACB, ALN, ACD (all variants).

The compatible-base header explicitly includes YBN-R/3 and YBV-R/4 (all variants). The body directs base wiring to Figure 1 and explicitly states that ACB-EW uses flying leads and its own fixing base.
The rendered page visibly contains separately labelled YBN-R/3 / YBN-R/3M, ACB-EW and YBV-R/4 wiring diagrams.
approved.limits: The source explicitly refers YBN-R/3(SCI) and YBN-R/3(SCI)M wiring to instruction 2-3-0-1499. The gallery note preserves that limit.

evidence: The source explicitly identifies 3000PLUS/BASE and 6000PLUS/BASE, including different continuity mechanisms.
Page 2 shows separately labelled 3000PLUS Detector Wiring Details and 6000PLUS Detector Wiring Details.
approved.limits: The 3000PLUS diode belongs to its own drawing; the 6000PLUS loop drawing is distinct, as preserved in the gallery note.

rejected.reason: The source names CHQ-ARI(CLR), while the existing target only records CHQ-ARI. No evidence establishes interchangeability of these variants.
rejected.resolution: Removed the generic device link; retained the correctly named CHQ-ARI(CLR) page for source-only gallery discovery.
